title: 第111章 要是输了，朕丢人，你丢命！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 别说舞台上的一众学子才子，就连满朝文武，这时也都猝不及防。谁都没想到孔诗岚仔仔细细讲了陆将军和唐小姐的凄美爱情，最后不是让人歌颂爱情，而是选这段爱情中的一个小插曲来写。写一个小插曲，这什么鬼逻辑？还写敬酒时陆将军的所思所想？鬼知道他当时想什么！“岚儿……这思绪，倒是清奇。”炎文帝端着茶杯，也是满脸惊诧，他也没想到孔诗岚会有这样的转折。难道小女生想要的，不是歌颂这段可歌可泣的爱情吗？怎么忽然去写了一个男人在面对爱而不得的女人时的心情去了？这什么脑回路？孔明箴老脸也在抽搐，他也没想到孙女不让他帮着出题，是想出这种题，这分明是想为难现场所有人啊！就这群上不过三十岁，下不过十七八岁的少年郎，连婚约都是父母之命媒妁之言，不能自己做主，他们懂个屁的爱情！更别说是可歌可泣的爱情悲剧了。孔明箴看向唐逸，呵呵，这兔崽子在幻音坊一夜御三女，让他写风流韵事肯定厉害，让他写爱而不得的爱情？可能吗？不可能！反正连他都写不出来。“写陆将军当时的心境？当时他肯定心都碎了吧？”“废话，心都碎了是没错，但你怎么表达出来？”“啊，这好难啊，感觉孔诗岚是故意为难人啊！”“……”舞台下，众人也是议论纷纷。就是杜凌菲，这时候美眸落在唐逸身上，也是轻微地眯了起来。写美人诗，那是唐逸的拿手好戏，随便一首出来都能流传后世。但要站在一个爱而不得的男人角度，他还能行吗？唯独她身侧的唐音，依旧低着头啃着猪蹄，仿佛周围的一切都和他没关系。怕啥！写诗而已，什么诗哥哥不能写？“岚姐，真坏……不，真厉害。”湖畔阁楼中，萧澜双手撑在下巴坐在窗前，看向孔诗岚的美眸亮晶晶。越难越好啊，越难唐逸写不出来，那就还是她孩子他爹。“孔姑娘，你确定要用这个题目？”唐画看向孔明箴，忍不住开口问道。要赞美可歌可泣的爱情，对他来说虽然有难度，但难度不大，但要写一个男人面对爱而不得的女人的感受，谁能写得出来？爱情？那对男人来说是最没有用，最没营养的东西。等位高权重，掌天下大权，什么样的女人没有？秦钰看向孔诗岚，眉头也是皱了皱。你让我写当时那女人的感受，我或许还行，你让我写男人的感受……我是个女人啊！宇文封冷冷瞥了一眼孔诗岚，呵，幼稚，男人想要女人直接抢就是了，还需要想什么？大炎的男人，就是愚昧愚蠢！孔诗岚见到舞台上一群士子才子僵硬的脸色，嘴角泛起笑容。“当然，就是这个题目。”“毕竟陆将军为前朝收复大片失地而战死，如此遗憾意难平，我其实也想知道……他当时见到唐小姐最后一面的时候，心里在想什么！”闻言，一群人都面露难色，他们一群连爱情都没有的人，怎么写？唐画是三元及第的状元，他很清楚要是没人写，那肯定会皇帝钦点第一个写。他可不想第一个丢人。而且，他需要时间堆砌辞藻。想到这里唐画轻笑一声，看向端着茶杯的唐逸道：“四弟，你不是小诗仙吗？想必已经胸有成竹了吧？”“说出来，让我们学习学习？”“毕竟，四弟你有爱而不得的人，恐怕更能了解其中滋味。”唐画笑容玩味，而众人听到这话都齐齐看向唐逸，杜凌菲和孔诗岚也都齐齐抬起头，美眸盯着唐逸。他有爱而不得的人？谁？没听说过啊！唐逸听到这话，也是一阵懵逼，我有爱而不得的人？我怎么不知道？不过很快，他就知道唐画说的是谁了。姜云娜！前身的确对姜云娜爱而不得，所以将姜云娜的记忆埋得非常深。可那是前身，关他什么事？唐逸放下茶杯，淡淡瞥了一眼唐画，冷笑道：“你说的是姜云娜吧？她？也配我唐逸爱而不得？你也太高看他了。”“不过，她和你渣男贱女，倒是天生一对。”听到这话，场下顿时响起窸窣的笑声，姜云娜听到这些笑声，气得脸都扭曲了起来。该死的，小诗仙又怎么样？你一个不受宠的废物，你也敢瞧不起我？画哥哥，帮我报仇，帮我狠狠地踩死他，我要让他知道在你面前，他就是蝼蚁！姜云娜攥紧拳头，在心头怒吼。唐画也是脸色铁青，眼底有寒意。“还有，别丢人现眼，这种事能咱们先来吗？”唐逸没有理会唐画，看向秦钰和宇文封：“两位远来是客，还是让你们两位先给我们展示展示吧！”秦钰转了转折扇，她心头是有了想法，但并没有成形，便笑道：“在下还没有写好，倒是唐四少号称小诗仙，应该已经写好了。”“不如，先拿出来我们见识见识。”宇文封冷冷地扫了一眼唐逸，冷笑。诗词？狗都不写！你先写，等你爬上巅峰，本王再将你踩入尘埃。唐逸看了眼秦钰，又看了眼唐画，道：“我是写好了没错，但我是给你们机会，我若先出手，你们就没有出手的机会了。”闻言，原本喧嚣的现场，顷刻间就安静了下来。所有人都盯着坐在舞台上嘴角带笑的唐逸身上，全都脸色震惊而错愕。“写好了？真的假的，这才多久他就写好了？”“不可能，这才这么点时间，连思绪都来不及整合吧？他居然就写好了？”“靠，不吹牛你会死吗？老子不信他写好了，一定是故弄玄虚。”“……”现场顿时沸腾起来，都戏谑嘲讽唐逸，没有人相信他写好了。炎文帝盯着唐逸，嘴角也是抽了抽，小子你最好重新组织一下语言，想清楚了再说。虽然朕相信你有出口成章的本事，但此时和往日不一样。输了，朕丢人，你丢命！你要考虑清楚啊！
content_en: Not to mention the students and talents on the stage, even the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty were caught off guard at this time.No one expected that Kong Shilanzai carefully talked about the poignant love between General Lu and Miss Tang. In the end, instead of letting people sing about love, he chose a small episode in this love to write about.Write an episode, what kind of logic is this?Also write about what General Lu was thinking during the toast?Who knows what he was thinking at that time!"Lan'er... these thoughts are quite strange." Emperor Yan Wen was holding the teacup, his face full of surprise. He did not expect that Kong Shilan would have such a turn.Could it be that what the little girl wants is not to sing the praises of this tragic love?Why did you suddenly write about a man's feelings when facing a woman he can't love?What kind of brain circuit is this?Kong Mingzhen's old face was also twitching. He didn't expect that his granddaughter wouldn't let him help with the questions. She came up with this kind of question. She clearly wanted to embarrass everyone present!This group of young men, who are no more than 30 years old and no more than 17 or 18 years old, even the marriage contract is ordered by their parents and the matchmaker. They cannot make their own decisions. They know nothing about love!Not to mention an evocative love tragedy.Kong Mingzhen looked at Tang Yi, haha, this bastard spent one night with three girls in Huanyinfang. He must be very powerful if he is asked to write about romantic affairs. But if he is asked to write about unrequited love?Is it possible?impossible!He couldn't even write it anyway."Write about General Lu's state of mind at that time? He must have been heartbroken at that time, right?" "Nonsense, it's true that he was heartbroken, but how do you express it?" "Ah, this is so difficult. I feel that Kong Shilan is deliberately making things difficult for others!" "..." Under the stage, everyone was also talking.It was Du Lingfei, whose beautiful eyes fell on Tang Yi at this time, and she narrowed slightly.Writing poems about beautiful women was Tang Yi's specialty, and any poem he wrote could be passed down to future generations.But from the perspective of a man who cannot love, can he still do it?Only Tang Yin beside her still lowered his head and gnawed on the pig's trotters, as if everything around him had nothing to do with him.What are you afraid of!It’s just poetry. What kind of poetry can’t my brother write?"Sister Lan, you are so bad... No, you are so powerful." In the lakeside attic, Xiao Lan sat in front of the window with her hands on her chin, looking at Kong Shilan's beautiful eyes.The harder it is, the better. The harder it is, if Tang Yi can't write it, then he is still the father of her child."Miss Kong, are you sure you want to use this title?" Tang Hua looked at Kong Mingzhen and couldn't help but ask.Although it is difficult for him to praise love that can be sung and cried, it is not that difficult, but to write about a man's feelings when faced with a woman he cannot love, who can write about it?love?That is the most useless and nutritious thing for men.What kind of woman doesn't have a high position and power in the world?Qin Yu looked at Kong Shilan and frowned.If you ask me to write about how that woman felt at that time, I might be okay. But if you ask me to write about how a man felt... I am a woman!Yu Wenfeng glanced at Kong Shilan coldly. Hehe, it's childish. If a man wants a woman, he can just grab her. What else do he need to think about?The man in Dayan is just ignorant and stupid!Kong Shilan saw the stiff faces of a group of scholars and talents on the stage, and a smile appeared on her lips."Of course, that's the title." "After all, General Lu died in the battle to regain a large area of ​​lost territory for the previous dynasty. It's so regretful that I can't bear to regret it. I actually want to know... what was he thinking when he saw Miss Tang for the last time!" Hearing this, a group of people looked embarrassed. How can they write about a group of people who don't even have love?Tang Hua was the number one scholar in the San Yuan Dynasty. He knew very well that if no one wrote it, the emperor would definitely write it first.He didn't want to be the first to be embarrassed.Moreover, he needs time to pile up the words.Thinking of this, Tang Hua chuckled and looked at Tang Yi who was holding the tea cup: "Fourth brother, aren't you a little poetry fairy? You must be confident already?" "Speak out and let us learn from it?" "After all, Fourth brother, you have people you can't love, so I'm afraid you can understand it better." Tang Hua smiled playfully, and when everyone heard this, they all looked at Tang Yi. Du Lingfei and Kong Shilan also raised their heads, staring at Tang Yi with their beautiful eyes.Does he have someone he can't love?who?Never heard of it!Tang Yi was confused when he heard this. Is there someone I can't love?How come I don't know?But soon, he knew who Tang Hua was talking about.Jiang Yunna!The predecessor was really in love with Jiang Yunna, so he buried Jiang Yunna's memory very deeply.But that's the predecessor, what does it have to do with him?Tang Yi put down the teacup, glanced at Tang Hua, and sneered: "You are talking about Jiang Yunna, right? She? Is she too worthy of my love, Tang Yi? You think too highly of him." "However, she and you, a scumbag and a bitch, are made for each other." Upon hearing this, rustling laughter suddenly rang out from the audience. When Jiang Yunna heard these laughters, her face twisted with anger.Damn it, what about the little Shixian?You are an unloved loser, how dare you look down on me?Brother Hua, help me take revenge and help me trample him to death. I want him to know that he is just an ant in front of you!Jiang Yunna clenched her fists and roared in her heart.Tang Hua's face was also livid, and there was a chill in his eyes."Also, don't be embarrassed. Can we do this first?" Tang Yi ignored Tang Hua and looked at Qin Yu and Yu Wenfeng: "You two are guests from afar, so let you two show it to us first!" Qin Yu turned the turning fan, and she was thinkingHe had an idea, but it didn't take shape, so he smiled and said, "I haven't written it yet, but Fourth Young Master Tang is known as the Little Poet Fairy, so he should have already written it." "Why don't you take it out first and let's see." Yu Wenfeng glanced at Tang Yi coldly and sneered.Poetry?Dogs don’t even write!You write first, and when you reach the top, I will step you into the dust.Tang Yi glanced at Qin Yu, then at Tang Hua, and said: "I have written it, yes, but I am giving you a chance. If I take action first, you will have no chance." Hearing this, the originally noisy scene suddenly became quiet.Everyone was staring at Tang Yi, who was sitting on the stage with a smile on his face, and their faces were all shocked and stunned."Has it been written? Is it true? How long did it take for him to finish it?" "It's impossible, it only took so long, and he didn't even have time to integrate his thoughts, right? He actually wrote it?" "Damn, will you die if you don't brag? I don't believe he has written it, he must be making a fool of himself." "..." The scene suddenly became excited, everyone was joking and mocking Tang Yi, no one believed that he had written it.Emperor Yan Wen stared at Tang Yi and twitched the corners of his mouth. Boy, you'd better reorganize your words and think clearly before speaking.Although I believe you have a clear plan
title_en: Chapter 111 If we lose, I will be embarrassed and you will lose your life!
